faq.q: How do I know a number is right?
faq.a: Open “How this is worked out” on any card. It shows the figures it is made of from the ledger, what it assumes and where each figure comes from.

faq.q: What if some entries are not posted yet?
faq.a: The number is marked as provisional, never shown as final. The drawer lists what is missing and what the number will be once it posts.

faq.q: Can reports come to me on a schedule?
faq.a: Yes. Schedule any report you may read to go to the people you choose, and send a test first.
